The text discusses the postharvest longevity of the cut flower Eustoma grandiflorum, commonly known as lisianthus, specifically the variety 'Mariachi Blue'. It examines the effects of a nanosilver (NS) based preservative compared to the standard preservative\u20148-hydroxyquinoline citrate (8-HQC) with sucrose (S). The study investigates the prevalence of porcine rotavirus antigen in pig-raising communities and institutional piggeries in Zaria, Kaduna State, Nigeria. A total of 376 faecal samples from pigs of various ages were collected from both backyard and institutional piggeries using convenience sampling. The observed variation in the levels of DNA integrity in different species of the marine gastropods can be attributed to various types of genotoxic compounds prevalent along the Goa coast. The text discusses a study on seabird abundances and breeding distribution in the northern sector of the Danco Coast, near the western Antarctic Peninsula, which has experienced significant temperature increases over the past 50 years. The research aimed to monitor the distribution and abundance of breeding populations during the 2010/11 season, focusing on various seabird species.
